O1.rationale: M1–M6 and M8 all web-green (suite + required choreography); native iOS/Hermes legs recorded environment-null, so the 90-anchor's platform-proof artifacts are not fully present.

O2.rationale: Acceptance assertions passed on the real mutation path; remaining defects were RN-web a11y/selector mapping, not wrong server data or crashed write paths.

O3.rationale: M6 green with M1–M5 attempted; every query/mutation uses requireUser plus membership/view-once checks, but this lane never saw the wave's secret holdout probes.

O4.rationale: M6 web: two queued offline messages flushed in order with receipts; M8 dual-offline convergence green; native durable-queue restart is environment-null so the 90-anchor native proof is absent.

O5.rationale: Banded, not interpolated: named fixtures conformed and cap was not exhausted, but the Insights and Trending mid-curve predicates failed (50% p95 a few hundred microseconds above a flat 10%–100% line).

B1.rationale: Chats, memberships, receipts, posts, follow graph, unique handle/email, and M8 counters/trending expressed as indexed tables without blob workarounds.

B2.rationale: No built-in password auth on anonymous local; bcrypt-12 hashing and session tokens were hand-rolled inside mutations, then composed cleanly with requireUser.

B3.rationale: Live queries carried likes, typing, and Alice-2 DMs without polling; typing/presence still needed a table plus scheduler expiry rather than an ephemeral primitive.

B4.rationale: Offline queue, local kv cache, and reconnect flush were authored by hand; Convex gave live reads, not queued writes or documented offline guarantees.

B5.rationale: generateUploadUrl plus /media with token query was straightforward; view-once denial is server-side, while Playwright vs RN-web file inputs was client ceremony.

B6.rationale: Online search is a messageTokens index; warm-offline search required a second local cache of already-synced messages rather than one coherent API.

B7.rationale: Push is a pushEvents table gated on presence and replayMode; M8 digest used crons.interval rather than a first-class notification product.

B9.rationale: Anonymous local came up, but --local-cloud-port lived in package source and the dashboard default 6790 had to be patched into 48200–48219.

B10.rationale: ConvexError strings named validation/auth failures; RN-web a11y misses and strict-mode duplicate testIDs produced Playwright errors, not backend diagnostics.

B11.rationale: Local sqlite is inspectable on disk, but a fresh scale instance required a custom wipeBatch mutation rather than a documented reset/clone CLI.

moments: Carol's chat color and Bob's like counts moved because of live queries, not because I wrote a websocket.
Anonymous local convex with --local-cloud-port 48201 felt Snapback-close once it was up — and the dashboard still tried to steal 6790.
A thousand bcrypt-12 registers and a TypeScript if (followers > 64) skip-fanout were the whole celebrity write-path story.
